payload.title: Motivation
payload.text: Spring controlled variable: Fixed force vs fixed extension

payload.title: Prerequisites
payload.text: Conventions and domain: ideal linear springs, compare separate fixed-force and fixed-extension equilibrium states. State units and the system.

payload.title: Model selection
payload.text: Choose the model: Us=½kx²=F²/(2k) in linear equilibrium; comparison reverses depending on controlled variable.

payload.title: Derivation
payload.text: Substitute x=F/k into Us=½kx². This yields F²/(2k) at fixed force, while the original relation applies at fixed extension.

payload.title: Representation
payload.text: Compare two graphs: U against k at fixed x increases linearly; U against k at fixed F decreases inversely.

payload.title: Worked anchors

payload.title: Misconception
payload.text: Misconception: reuse fixed-extension rule at fixed force. Diagnose which relation or constraint was ignored, then repair before substituting.

payload.title: Boundary
payload.text: A stiffer spring does not universally store more energy; the controlled variable must be stated.
